whatItIs.statement: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

howToUse.statement: Compose Avatar with AvatarImage and AvatarFallback; AvatarBadge may be added inside the Avatar.
Compose AvatarGroup from Avatar children and use AvatarGroupCount for the number of additional avatars.

options.statement: Use the size prop with sm, default, or lg to change the avatar size.

Use shape="circle" (the default) for people. Use shape="rounded" or shape="square" for organizations, workspaces and product logos such as a sidebar header or workspace switcher. AvatarImage, AvatarFallback and the border follow the shape.
